scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix worker" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.admin:make: wrangler d1 execute telecloud --command "UPDATE users SET is_admin=1 WHERE id=1" --remote
